proved_scope: For all real epsilon, chi, b2, and b3, the finite covariant matrix boostedB has uChi chi in its right kernel: boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3).mulVec (uChi chi) = 0.
repair_note: The preserved interrupted attempt had exit 130 with no Lean diagnostic. A first recovery proof exposed only matrix-linearity reduction errors; the final proof explicitly rewrites matrix add/scalar mulVec linearity, applies the three finite contraction lemmas, and normalizes by ring.
limitations: This proves finite kernel membership only.
It does not prove uniqueness, rank, a complete G03-B countersequence, or scientific admission.
